description: Identify a product from a URL, model number, SKU, ASIN, UPC/EAN or description, and get its compatibility profile: the standards it takes and provides (mounts, sockets, connectors, platforms, part numbers, sizes), numeric limits (OS version, watts, weight, screen size), evidence and freshness. Products not in our reviewed catalog are researched on demand from the manufacturer's page and returned with status read_from_manufacturer_page (unreviewed) or unconfirmed (not enough to decide on). Use first when the product could be anything.

product.description: Anything that identifies the product: a manufacturer or retailer URL, a model number, SKU, ASIN, UPC/EAN, a vehicle VIN, or a listing title / description.

research.description: Default true. Set false to look only in the reviewed catalog (no on-demand research).

role.description: Optional: is this something the person already owns, or something being considered? Helps when a product is both (a phone owns cases; a car mount holds phones).

name: identify_product
title: Identify any product
